job.title: Engineering Manager, Frontend Platform & Mobile
job.description: Lead and grow a frontend platform team owning Zocdoc's accessible React component library and design system. Define roadmap and technical strategy, drive adoption across web and mobile, institutionalize accessibility and quality, mentor engineers, partner with UX/Product/Analytics, and deliver platform improvements that speed frontend and mobile development.
responsibilities: Leading, managing, and growing a high-performing team of frontend engineers
Owning the strategy and roadmap for Zocdoc's design system and accessible React component library
Driving accessibility across Zocdoc's web and mobile surfaces
Partnering with UX, Product, and Engineering to build and evolve a scalable, accessible, mobile-responsive component library
Identifying and delivering platform improvements to speed up frontend and mobile development
Mentoring and coaching engineers at all levels
Setting technical strategy focused on scalability and developer experience
Contributing to engineering culture at Zocdoc
